title: Plan lane file
description: One kanban lane of a project's plan zone. The file name is the lane; the sequence order is the human ranking within it.

lane.description: Must equal the file's basename. A cache of the file name so a pasted fragment is self-describing.

slices.description: Ordered highest-priority first. Position is the ranking; there is no priority field.

id.description: Quoted. Unquoted 007 is octal 7 under YAML 1.1.

slug.description: Cache of the slice directory's suffix. Never edited here.

appetite.description: Cache of the slice README's Appetite section. Never edited here; changing a budget is a slice revision.

needs.description: Ids that must be closed before this slice may enter doing.

tags.description: Free board labels. Presentation only; nothing gates on a tag.

outcome.description: Required in closed.yml, forbidden elsewhere. The lane no longer carries the terminal distinction, so the entry must.

succeeded_by.description: Required when outcome is reshaped, forbidden otherwise.
